Informational: EnclaveService.canonical() sorts only the top-level map (TreeMap + Jackson default) while the coordinator's Canonicalizer sorts recursively. These are independent signature domains (enclave manifest vs Dowsure submission envelope) and never cross-verify, so the coordinator correctly matches the Python coordinator rather than the enclave. Noted so a future reader does not assume the two canonicalizers are interchangeable.
